title: Coordinate Reference System and Datum
description: Canonical CRS/datum specification for all Earth coordinate claims. No coordinate without CRS. No depth without datum.

crs_id.description: EPSG code or coordinate system name. Examples: EPSG:4326, EPSG:32646, LOCAL-UTM-ZONE46N

datum.description: Vertical and horizontal datum. Examples: WGS84, ED50, Kertau, GDM2000

vertical_datum.description: Vertical datum for depth/elevation. Examples: MSL, LAT, CD, SD

authority.description: Organization or standard that defines this CRS. Examples: EPSG, OGP, NOC, ExxonMobil

area_of_use.description: Geographic area where this CRS is valid. Examples: Malaysia, North Sea, Gulf of Mexico

projection_method.description: For projected CRS only. Projection method. Examples: Transverse Mercator, UTM

validation_status.description: Whether this CRS has been validated against authoritative source

source_file_hash.description: SHA256 hash of source file defining this CRS

ingested_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this CRS was ingested

note.description: Any caveats or known issues with this CRS
